name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-cave-water
title: Super Mario World - Cave Water
description:
A layer 3 variant of the water seen in cave levels In SMW. You can set it to act like tides or something else.
(Note in order to not have Mario be pushed by a current you may have to use a hex edit. Also note that you may have to mess around with the “Initial Y Position” values which can be found in the layer 3 settings)
